items.title: Timeline for Polish nuclear units slips in updated programme
items.summary: Poland's Council of Ministers has adopted an update to the country's nuclear power programme - a strategic document outlining the development of nuclear energy in Poland - with the first nuclear power plant now expected to start up in 2036 and the second one in 2040.

items.title: Orano inaugurates lead-212 production facility
items.summary: An opening ceremony has been held for Europe's first industrial-scale facility for the production of lead-212-based targeted alpha therapies, the Alpha Therapy Laboratory in Valenciennes, France.

items.title: Green Party drops nuclear phase-out policy
items.summary: Members of the Green Party of England and Wales have voted at their autumn conference to include nuclear among a list of low-carbon forms of energy.
